commands.name: fzf
commands.description: Fuzzy-search over stdin and output selected items to stdout

flags.name: --query
flags.description: Start the finder with the given query

flags.name: --filter
flags.description: Filter mode: apply the query and exit without interactive UI

flags.name: --multi
flags.description: Enable multi-select with Tab/Shift-Tab

flags.name: --no-sort
flags.description: Do not sort the result

flags.name: --reverse
flags.description: Display in reverse order (prompt at top)

flags.name: --exact
flags.description: Enable exact-match

flags.name: --delimiter
flags.description: Field delimiter regex for nth and with-nth (default: AWK-style)

flags.name: --nth
flags.description: Comma-separated list of field index expressions for search scope

flags.name: --with-nth
flags.description: Transform presentation of each line using field index expressions

flags.name: --prompt
flags.description: Input prompt (default: '> ')

flags.name: --header
flags.description: String to print as sticky header

flags.name: --header-lines
flags.description: Treat N lines of input as sticky header

flags.name: --preview
flags.description: Command to execute as preview for the focused item (use {} as placeholder)

flags.name: --preview-window
flags.description: Preview window layout (e.g. right:50%:wrap)

flags.name: --bind
flags.description: Custom key binding (key:action, e.g. ctrl-a:select-all)

flags.name: --height
flags.description: Display fzf window below the cursor with the given height (e.g. 40%)

flags.name: --min-height
flags.description: Minimum height when --height is given as a percent

flags.name: --border
flags.description: Draw border around the finder: rounded, sharp, bold, block, etc.

flags.name: --ansi
flags.description: Enable processing of ANSI color codes in input

flags.name: --color
flags.description: Color scheme (e.g. dark, light, 16, bw, or custom fg:N,bg:N)

flags.name: --no-mouse
flags.description: Disable mouse

flags.name: --print0
flags.description: Separate output items with NUL instead of newline

flags.name: --read0
flags.description: Read input items delimited by NUL instead of newline

flags.name: --select-1
flags.description: Automatically select the only match

flags.name: --exit-0
flags.description: Exit immediately when there's no match
